open_questions.question: Does a universal seven-source singleton word of length 20 or 22 exist at all (with repeated boundary states, |P| < L), or is the Gray bound 24 sharp?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It settles f(7) in {20, 22, 24} and the all-127-row batch bill inside the unchanged PR943 model.
open_questions.first_step: Extend the resumable restricted-growth census to the repeated-state L=20 splits (10,9), (10,8), (9,9), (10,7) with per-split collision budgets derived from lemma_a_table rows, and to the simple L=22 (11,11) split; the deterministic ILS ceilings 120/126 with an L=24 control are the search-level baseline to beat.
open_questions.blocked_by: The repeated-state splits need multiset collision semantics with per-split budgets and grow well past the simple-cycle tree; the full L=20 tree at ~nodes-per-shard recorded in CENSUS20-PROGRESS.json exceeds a single session at the observed node rate.

open_questions.question: Is r((C2)^7) = 20, i.e. do 19-point or 18-point covers of F2^7 exist (the restricted addition basis value; PR 2542 open question 2)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It settles the set-level analogue of the community's r((C2)^6) = 14 fact and bounds how small a walk's prefix set could be.
open_questions.first_step: Shard the joint (E,O) cover enumeration for splits (10,9), (9,10), (10,8), (8,10), (9,9) at k=19 and (9,9) at k=18 with the shared-support identity, or orbit-reduce under the 5,040 coordinate permutations as PR 2542's open question 2 records.
open_questions.blocked_by: Set-level ILS finds 20-point covers easily (14 in 30 restarts) but no 19-point cover in 200 restarts (max 124/128); the exact joint tree stalls without orbit reduction. Search failure is not an exclusion.

open_questions.question: Can a covering set be walk-shaped at all: does any cover of F2^7 at k in {20, 22} have min induced hypercube degree >= 2 (a closed-walk precondition)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Every sampled cover has isolated vertices (463 covers at k=20/22, all with min degree 0), while every walk-shaped set the ILS reaches stops at 126/128; a proof that covers and walk-shape are incompatible at k <= 22 would give f(7) = 24 (Gray sharp) by PR 2542's f(7) >= 20 plus a length-22 exclusion.
open_questions.first_step: Run a constrained search maximizing |P+P| over cycle-shaped sets (the word ILS with more budgets/stronger moves), or derive an additive-combinatorial obstruction for autocorrelation-covering sets that contain a Hamiltonian cycle.
open_questions.blocked_by: No structural lemma yet: covers exist with slack (190 pair sums at k=20) and the walk constraint is combinatorial, not additive.
